comparison_with_A_Born.A_Born: one abstract structural axiom fixes probability descent but does not itself supply an event trajectory
comparison_with_A_Born.A_PRM: one stronger stochastic primitive gives the same descent plus actual event times and stable record labels
comparison_with_A_Born.logical_status: A_PRM is a constructive one-primitive completion, not a zero-primitive derivation from current MTT geometry
comparison_with_A_Born.noncircularity_guard: the marked process does not derive the quadratic intensity assignment; that assignment is the explicit coupling clause of A_PRM, so this result adds trajectories rather than reducing the logical assumption count below A_Born

deterministic_circle_no_go.conclusion: constant-speed shared-circle traversal is not a positive-rate memoryless clock; Haar phase and a threshold partition alone do not supply actualization
deterministic_circle_no_go.conditional_law: given U_0 outside the arc, the first-entry time has bounded support of normalized length 2/3
deterministic_circle_no_go.test_flow: U_t=U_0+omega t mod 1 with Haar-distributed U_0
deterministic_circle_no_go.unconditional_law: has an atom of mass 1/3 at t=0 when U_0 begins in the target arc

external_alignment.exact_race: the construction is the marked-Poisson/competing-channel theorem underlying exact stochastic simulation methods
external_alignment.mtt_specific_input: the normalized hazards, q79 P_Haar/Q record geometry and shared mark circle are MTT inputs; Poisson independent increments are not
external_alignment.reference: D. T. Gillespie, A general method for numerically simulating the stochastic time evolution of coupled chemical reactions, J. Comput. Phys. 22 (1976), 403-434, doi:10.1016/0021-9991(76)90041-3

frontier_delta.after: one explicit marked-Poisson primitive is proved sufficient for memoryless capture, exact quadratic record weights, coarse graining, second-moment descent and realized trajectories
frontier_delta.before: the q79 jump generator and quadratic hazards were exact, but no objective stochastic event law selected one outgoing record
frontier_delta.blocker_state: B.QM.01 remains open at the selected-source tier because A_PRM is not derived or adopted and the full same-action apparatus configuration map remains open

marked_poisson_theorem.actual_record: the first point (T,U) after coupling is an objective event; its record is the unique a with U in A_C,a(z)
conclusions: T is exponential with rate gamma_C
the restricted processes on disjoint record arcs are independent Poisson processes with rates gamma_C r_C,a(z)
coarse-graining is union of mark arcs
a common rate scale changes waiting times but not record weights

domain_and_error.domain: finite-dimensional normalized detector families, a preparation fixed until first capture, finite gamma_C>0 and measurable stable-record mark arcs
domain_and_error.error: exact; no discretization or asymptotic approximation
domain_and_error.open_extension: time-dependent states and hazards require the predictable thinning version tied to the same physical action

marked_poisson_theorem.input: normalized finite detector hazards r_C,a(z)=||M_C,a z||^2, sum_a r_C,a(z)=1, and one physical total rate gamma_C
marked_poisson_theorem.mark_partition: choose the stable record ordering and partition S1_shared into measurable arcs A_C,a(z) with Haar length r_C,a(z)
marked_poisson_theorem.point_process: N_C is Poisson on R_+ x S1_shared with intensity gamma_C dt tensor m_Haar

second_moment_descent.consequence: A_PRM implies A_Born: SecondMomentCaptureDescent and also supplies an explicit realized-record trajectory

shared_circle_gauge.anchor: one context pointer phase chooses where the first arc begins
shared_circle_gauge.gauge_invariance: simultaneous rotation of every arc preserves Haar lengths and all event probabilities
shared_circle_gauge.label_covariance: permuting stable record labels and their arcs together only permutes the outcome coordinates

stochastic_primitive.name: A_PRM: shared-circle marked Poisson actualization
stochastic_primitive.statement: on noncompact physical time R_+ times the shared mark circle, there is one unit-intensity independently scattered Poisson random measure; the physical context rate rescales time and the action-selected normalized detector hazards partition its marks
stochastic_primitive.type_guard: R_+ is physical temporal order; S1_shared is only the compact Haar mark/holonomy carrier and is not identified with time
